main_text.l: S. S. Th. Doctori ejusdemque Professori Primario,
Collegii Sapientiæ Ephoro, & Consiliario Ecclesiastico Meritissimo,
p. t. Facultatis suæ Decano Spectatissimo.
Sacræ Theologiæ Doctori, ejusque ut & Linguæ
Quum versarentur ἐν παρασκευῇ [?] festivitatis Jubilaicæ in Academia
sua ad diem XXV Novembr. st. n. Anno M. DC. LXXXVI.

page.notes: The Greek words "ἐν παρασκευῇ" and "χαριτομετρίας" are read from a slightly blurred scan and may not be exact. The top-left and right edges of the page are damaged, and show-through from the reverse is faintly visible in the background; neither is transcribed.
